name: Pathfinder
description: Two-stage orbital rocket with a crew capsule that comes home behind a heat shield: ~160 t at liftoff, ~10.1 km/s of delta-v in vacuum, enough for low Earth orbit with a good ascent. Stages: 0 booster, 1 upper stage, 2 capsule separation, 3 main parachute (opens below 250 m/s in thick enough air). Power: the capsule's batteries, about a day and a half.
notes: Parts from the top down. stage: the stage (0 first, Space) that ignites an engine or fires a separator, dropping everything below it.
